data.name: Nur
data.gender_notes: Nur is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic teachings, the name Nur refers to the light of Allah that guides and illuminates the path of believers. It is derived from the Arabic root 'n-r-y', which signifies light, illumination, and enlightenment. The name Nur carries the meaning “Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nur usually hope their child will grow to embody light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nur belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nur total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: نور
in_arabic.meaning: نور الاله نور الجنان نور القلوب
in_arabic.long_meaning: النور هو مصدر من أصول صحيحة وجميلة، ويأتي من الجذر النور، وهو مصدر للعمل المضيء، ويترجم إلى الإضاءة، والضياء، والهيئة، والصورة، وهو مصدر للعلم والفهم، ويستخدم في القرآن الكريم في العديد من الآيات، مثل: سوره الإسراء: 27، وسوره طه: 35، وسوره النور: 35، ويستخدم لوصف الله في القرآن، ويستخدم للوصف الإلهي، ويستخدم في الأسماء التي تعني الإضاءة، أو النور المادي، أو النور الروحي، ويستخدم في تسمية الأطفال، ويعد من الأسماء الشائعة في العالم الإسلامي، ويعتبر من الأسماء التي لها أهمية دينية وثقافية

in_english.long_meaning: The name Nur is derived from the Arabic root, which means light. It is a divine name that refers to the light of God. The name Nur is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Imran and Surah An-Nur. The name Nur is considered one of the beautiful names of God. It is also used to describe the light of guidance and wisdom. In Islamic tradition, the name Nur is associated with the qualities of illumination, knowledge, and understanding. It is a popular name among Muslims and is often given to children
